what: Simulations of each dataset of tab:datasets (train, validation and test splits) by melt regime, as aiida-pino categorizes them (aiida_pino.console.viz.classify_regime): lack of fusion when the cavity is under 2 cells deep; keyhole when the time-averaged cavity aspect ratio exceeds 1 and the cavity reaches 2.1 beam radii; conduction otherwise. Computed 2026-10-29 on the deposited simulations.
